There is a football game in
Big Stadium now!

There is a baseball game
in Big Stadium now!

There is a soccer game
in Big Stadium now!

You sure look up to athletes when
you're a kid.

I'm raising the same Pokémon as
my favorite athlete's Pokémon.

When I throw a Poké Ball, I copy the
throwing form of a quarterback!

When I throw a Poké Ball, I copy the form
of a pitcher!

When I throw a Poké Ball, I copy the
throw-in of a keeper!
